title: LitBench: A Benchmark and Dataset for Reliable Evaluation of Creative Writing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model preferences on story pairs with varying length differences and training ablative reward models on length-unfiltered datasets to demonstrate that models strongly prefer longer text when not explicitly mitigated.
Measuring zero-shot LLM judge performance by permuting the position of the stories (Option A vs. Option B) and analyzing the results to account for the model's preference based on presentation order.
